gripOrHq.title: MIT West Tier
gripOrHq.rulesText: Shuffle your hand, trash, and stack together, and then draw five cards. When you play MIT West Tier, remove it from the game instead of trashing it.

gripOrHq.title: All-Nighter
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run; whether or not that run is successful, you may then make another run.

gripOrHq.title: Broker
gripOrHq.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.

root.title: Roving Submarine
root.rulesText:
Install only inside a subsidiary data fort. This fort may be run only if you installed or advanced a card inside or on this fort during your last turn.
Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.
